records.source: Classifier fitted by ml_analysis to separate positive- from negative-control wells and rank per-object features by permutation importance. Options are logistic_regression (default: features standardised, then an L2-penalised fit, so it stays stable when features approach the number of training wells), shrinkage_lda (standardised linear discriminant analysis with automatic covariance shrinkage), xgboost, lightgbm, catboost, random_forest, extra_trees, gradient_boosting, svm and mlp; lightgbm and catboost require their optional packages. Unregularised discriminant analysis is deliberately not offered: it collapses when features roughly equal training wells. reg_alpha, reg_lambda and learning_rate affect only boosted models.
records.translation: ml_analysis 拟合的分类器,用于区分阳性对照孔与阴性对照孔,并按置换重要性对每个对象的特征排序。可选项为 logistic_regression(默认:先将特征标准化,再用 L2 惩罚拟合,因此当特征数接近训练孔数时仍保持稳定)、shrinkage_lda(带协方差自动收缩的标准化线性判别分析)、xgboost、lightgbm、catboost、random_forest、extra_trees、gradient_boosting、svm 和 mlp;lightgbm 和 catboost 需要各自的可选软件包。有意不提供未正则化的判别分析:当特征数大致等于训练孔数时它会失效。reg_alpha、reg_lambda 和 learning_rate 只影响提升(boosted)模型。
